answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 7 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the whisper cliff is fixed at deposit and published in the river ledger, the echo audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. A farm of 91 pays that 273 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
